title: Blaster — complete skill frame set
source: maplestory.io, GMS version 270 (skillbook API; WZ API for 5th/6th-job paths/metadata)

skills.name: Blast Shield
skills.description: When attacked by an enemy, generates a protective shield proportional to the damage taken. The total of the shield and current HP can't exceed the max HP or the shield will disappear. While using Blaster skills, you cannot be knocked back.

skills.name: Revolving Cannon Mastery
skills.description: Study the Arm Cannon to learn the basics of Revolving Cannon. Any enemies attacked directly by an Arm Cannon will receive additional damage due to the excess heat.

skills.name: Magnum Punch
skills.description: Unleashes a powerful straight punch in front of you with the explosive power of the Arm Cannon. Revolving Cannon triggers automatically when using this skill. You can also link this skill to Double Blast and Bullet Blast.

skills.name: Revolving Cannon
skills.description: Use your Arm Cannon to create additional explosions and deal damage. This cannot be used as a standalone skill. Either it triggers automatically during certain attacks or can be used manually during a certain attack.\nHolding the key down to charge will manually reload your Ammo. You can charge while using other skills, and can charge up to 2 skills simultaneously.\nSkills triggered automatically during Revolving Cannon: Magnum Punch, Double Blast

skills.name: Bunker Buster Explosion
skills.description: Depletes the Dynamo Gauge to fire your Bunker Buster, releasing explosions and shockwaves. Ignores Defense Rate of enemies in melee range. Can be linked into Hammer Smash.\nThe Dynamo Gauge charges when using Revolving Cannon during certain offensive skills. Additional shockwaves are released based on Dynamo Gauge bars used, dealing extra damage based on proximity. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Double Jump
skills.description: Allows you to double jump.

skills.name: Detonate
skills.description: Fire your cannon to thrust in the direction opposite the way you are facing. The recoil that thrusts you will also damage nearby enemies. Using the skill while holding the up arrow key will cause an explosion on the ground that propels you upward. Attacking an enemy with attack reflection will not damage you, and the skill cannot be used while reloading.

skills.name: Arm Cannon Mastery
skills.description: Increases Arm Cannon Mastery, Critical Rate, and Attack Power.

skills.name: Physical Training
skills.description: Permanently increases STR and DEX through sheer physical training.

skills.name: Charge Mastery
skills.description: Maintain control over your power to improve charge skills. Additionally, permanently increases Damage.

skills.name: Revolving Cannon Plus
skills.description: Improves the performance of the Revolving Cannon embedded within your Arm Cannon.

skills.name: Double Blast
skills.description: Performs a powerful 2-hit combo in the direction you're facing using the momentum from your Arm Cannon. After you learn this skill, you can also activate it by repeatedly pressing the Magnum Punch button. Revolving Cannon triggers automatically when using this skill. Can be linked to Bobbing, Weaving, Hammer Smash, Shotgun Punch, or Bullet Blast.

skills.name: Bobbing
skills.description: Move forward while avoiding enemy attacks. Jumping will cancel this skill immediately. With Action Customization enabled, pressing the skill key again will cancel the skill immediately. Can be linked to Magnum Punch, Rocket Rush, or Bullet Blast.\nIf activated after a charge, any of your skill that was already activated will be canceled, and Bobbing will be activated. You can charge a skill while using a different skill other than Bobbing, and up to 2 skills can be charged simultaneously. Also permanently increases Magnum Punch damage.\nRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF.

skills.name: Arm Cannon Boost
skills.description: Doubles the Attack Speed of your weapon. Must have a Arm Cannon equipped.

skills.name: Revolving Cannon Plus II
skills.description: Improves the performance of the Revolving Cannon embedded within your Arm Cannon. This overwrites the increases from Revolving Cannon Plus.

skills.name: Shield Training
skills.description: Fortify your Blast Shield with some training. Also permanently increases Final Damage.

skills.name: Combo Training
skills.description: Research the most efficient movement and attack patterns to increase your abilities in battle.

skills.name: Hammer Smash
skills.description:
Strikes the ground with tremendous force to send enemies reeling.
Can be linked to Magnum Punch or Bullet Blast.
Charge the skill by holding down the key. While charging, attacks won't knock you back. Releasing the charge will cancel any of your active skills and will activate Hammer Smash.
You can charge this skill while using other skills, except for Hammer Smash. Up to 2 skills may be charged at once.
While Cannon Overdrive's cylinder gauge overheat reduction is active, Hammer Smash is converted into Hammer Smash Blast.
Also permanently increases Double Blast damage.

skills.name: Hammer Smash Blast
skills.description: Strikes the ground to knock nearby enemies into the air. While charging, attacks won't knock you back.\nCan be linked with Magnum Punch or Bullet Blast.

skills.name: Weaving
skills.description: Move backward while avoiding enemy attacks. Jumping will cancel this skill immediately. With Action Customization enabled, press the skill key again to immediately cancel it. Can be linked to Rocket Rush, Muzzle Flash, or Bullet Blast.\nIf activated after a charge, any of your skill that was already activated will be canceled, and Weaving will be activated. You can charge a skill while using a different skill other than Weaving, and up to 2 skills can be charged simultaneously. Additionally, permanently increases Magnum Punch damage.\nRight-click to toggle Action Customization ON/OFF.

skills.name: Rocket Rush
skills.description: Grab onto nearby enemies and drag them in the direction you're facing. Any enemy in your path will be bulldozed along and receive damage. This skill will not be activated if there are no enemies nearby to grab. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Magnum Cannon
skills.description: The cannon built into the Arm Cannon fires an explosive shell forward.

skills.name: Muzzle Flash
skills.description: Instantly approaches a nearby enemy while Weaving to perform an attack. Can only be used during Weaving, and can be activated by Weaving (unless Action Customization is enabled for that skill). If command is locked, it will not activate even if you use the skill while Weaving. It will not be activated if there is no enemy within range. Can be linked to Magnum Punch and Bullet Blast, and permanently increases Magnum Punch damage.\nRight-click to lock command

skills.name: Revolving Cannon Plus III
skills.description: The final upgrade for the Revolving Cannon embedded within your Arm Cannon. This overwrites the increases from Revolving Cannon Plus II.

skills.name: Shield Training II
skills.description: Enhance the Blast Shield through rigorous mental training and perseverance. Additionally, permanently increase the damage of Rocket Rush and Magnum Cannon.

skills.name: Gauntlet Expert
skills.description: Increases Arm Cannon Mastery, Critical Damage, and Damage when attacking Boss Monsters.

skills.name: Advanced Charge Mastery
skills.description: Maintain control over your power to optimize charge skills. Overwrites the buffs from Charge Mastery. Additionally, permanently ignores a portion of enemies' Defense when attacking, and decreases damage taken.

skills.name: Combo Training II
skills.description: Research the most efficient movement and attack patterns to increase your abilities in battle. Abilities that increase Skill Link Speed and Final Damage override enhancements from Combo Training.

skills.name: Power Punch
skills.description: Increases the damage of Magnum Punch, Double Blast, Hammer Smash Blast, Shotgun Punch, Muzzle Flash, and Ballistic Hurricane.

skills.name: Piercing Punch
skills.description: Increases Ignore Defense from Magnum Punch, Double Blast, Hammer Smash Blast, Shotgun Punch, Muzzle Flash, and Ballistic Hurricane.

skills.name: Punching Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases the number of attacks for Hammer Smash Blast and Shotgun Punch.

skills.name: Improved Bunker Explosion
skills.description: Increases the damage of Bunker Buster Explosion.

skills.name: Improved Bunker Shockwave
skills.description: Increases the damage of the shockwave generated by Bunker Buster Explosion.

skills.name: Bunker Buster Explosion - Guard Bonus
skills.description: Grants a guarding bonus during Bunker Buster Explosion.

skills.name: Blast Shield Recovery
skills.description: While the Blast Shield dissipates, recover your HP relative to the rate at which your shield dissipates.

skills.name: Speedy Vitality Shield
skills.description: Reduces the cooldown of Vitality Shield.

skills.name: Ballistic Hurricane - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Ballistic Hurricane.

skills.name: Shotgun Punch
skills.description: Fires a Screw Blow. Can be linked with Bobbing, Weaving, and Bullet Blast. Also permanently increases Double Blast damage.

skills.name: Ballistic Hurricane
skills.description: Unleash all of your fighting prowess to create a storm that sweeps enemies in a wide range. Also permanently increases damage of Hammer Smash Blast.

skills.name: Revolving Blast
skills.description: Reloads Ammo. Unleash a powerful explosion to suppress enemies.

skills.name: Vitality Shield
skills.description: Convert an active Blast Shield to HP. You can't use this without a Blast Shield active, or if your HP is full. For a brief moment after using this skill, damage from attacks, including attacks that deal a percentage of your HP, will be reduced. The damage reduction is determined by the damage reduction of Charge Mastery. This buff is not affected by buff duration extension effects. Additionally, this skill permanently increases Rocket Rush and Magnum Cannon damage.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description: Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.\nCan be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Defensive Overdrive
skills.description: Transcend your limits to raise an unbreakable defense. The skill can be canceled by using it again. Not affected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Cannon Overdrive
skills.description: By charging Revolving Cannon to its limit, increase its power and reduce reload time, all while increasing the rate at which the Dynamo Gauge cools down.

skills.name: Hyper Magnum Punch
skills.description:
Rush forward with a powerful punch to cause a colossal explosion. 
Hold down the skill key to charge. This skill generates additional shockwaves based on charge time, dealing more damage to nearby enemies. While charging, you cannot be stunned or knocked back, and you will have improved defense and Abnormal Status resistance.
Additionally, being attacked while charging will improve your final damage output.
Hyper Magnum Punch's charge time is unaffected by Charge Mastery's charge time reduction effect.

skills.name: For Liberty
skills.description: Materializes the will of the Resistance to increase attack power.

skills.name: Cannon Overdrive
skills.description: By charging Revolving Cannon to its limit, increase its power and reduce reload time, all while increasing the rate at which the Dynamo Gauge cools down.

skills.name: Rocket Punch
skills.description: Load up your Arm Cannon with armor-piercing ammo and deliver an earth-shattering punch. Rocket Punch is not affected by Revolving Cannon's Boost Node.

skills.name: Gatling Punch
skills.description: Throws a rapid barrage of punches out in front of you. Grants Enhanced Guard. Prevents Knockback and critical Abnormal Statuses.

skills.name: Bullet Blast
skills.description: Use the Revolver Gauntlet to unleash the combined power of all of your bullets in one concussive blast. The Charge and explosion deal damage to enemies even when they are under attack reflection. The Charge action cannot be canceled by the Charge Skill, but pressing the skill again will immediately explode. If you press the down arrow key when you release the skill key, it will attack in place instead of charging forward.

skills.name: Afterimage Shock
skills.description: A powerful attack creates afterimage-like shockwaves, which sweep through enemies. The afterimages' attacks are unaffected by attack reflection. Using the skill again, while its effect is active, will cancel that effect.

skills.name: Afterimage Shock
skills.description: Generates afterimage-like shockwaves.

skills.name: HEXA Magnum Punch
skills.description: Unleashes a more powerful straight punch in front of you with the explosive power of the Arm Cannon. Revolving Cannon triggers automatically when using this skill. You can also link this skill to HEXA Double Blast and Bullet Blast.

skills.name: HEXA Double Blast
skills.description: Performs a more powerful 2-hit combo in the direction you're facing using the momentum from your Arm Cannon. After you learn this skill, you can also activate it by repeatedly pressing the HEXA Magnum Punch button. Revolving Cannon triggers automatically when using this skill. Can be linked to Bobbing, Weaving, Hammer Smash, Shotgun Punch, or Bullet Blast.

skills.name: HEXA Bunker Buster Explosion
skills.description: Depletes the Dynamo Gauge to release massive explosions and shockwaves. Using it a set amount of times enables the use of Burst Pile Bunker, which can create powerful explosions from the fully charged cylinder.\nIgnores Defense Rate of enemies in melee range. Can be linked to Hammer Smash.\nAdditional shockwaves are released based on Dynamo Gauge bars used, dealing extra damage based on proximity. Requires at least 3 Dynamo Gauge bars and is unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Burst Pile Bunker
skills.description: Discharge the heat generated from other blasts to create a powerful multi-layered explosion.\nUsable once the Dynamo Gauge has at least 6 bars and a requisite number of HEXA Bunker Buster Explosions have been used.\nBurst Pile Bunker ignores the Defense Rate of enemies and is unaffected by attack reflection. Can be linked to Hammer Smash.

skills.name: HEXA Revolving Cannon Mastery
skills.description: Any enemies attacked directly by an Arm Cannon will receive additional damage due to the excess heat.

skills.name: HEXA Hammer Smash
skills.description:
Strike the ground with tremendous force to send enemies reeling.
Can be linked to Magnum Punch or Bullet Blast.
Charge the skill by holding down the key. While charging, attacks won't knock you back. Releasing the charge will cancel any of your active skills and will activate Hammer Smash.
You can charge this skill while using other skills, except for Hammer Smash. Up to 2 skills may be charged at once.
While Cannon Overdrive's cylinder gauge overheat reduction is active, Hammer Smash is converted into Hammer Smash Blast.
Also permanently increases HEXA Magnum Punch and HEXA Double Blast damage.

skills.name: HEXA Hammer Smash Blast
skills.description: Strikes the ground to knock nearby enemies into the air. While charging, attacks won't knock you back.\nCan be linked with Magnum Punch or Bullet Blast.

skills.name: HEXA Shotgun Punch
skills.description: Fire a Screw Blow. Can be linked with Bobbing, Weaving, and Bullet Blast.

skills.name: HEXA Revolving Cannon
skills.description: Use your Arm Cannon to create additional explosions and deal damage. This cannot be used as a standalone skill. Either it triggers automatically during certain attacks or can be used manually during a certain attack.\nHolding the key down to charge will manually reload your Ammo. You can charge while using other skills, and can charge up to 2 skills simultaneously.\nSkills triggered automatically during Revolving Cannon: Magnum Punch, Double Blast

skills.name: HEXA Ballistic Hurricane
skills.description: Unleash all of your fighting prowess to create a storm that sweeps enemies in a wide range.

skills.name: Final Destroyer
skills.description:
Pushes the power of the Arm Cannon to its limit before taking to the air and raining destruction.
While Rocket Punch is active, enemies hit by Final Destroyer will be hit by an enhanced Rocket Punch.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Vanguard Strike
skills.description:
Charges the Arm Cannon's pile bunker with ultra-compressed energy, firing bullets that cause massive shockwaves upon impact and cover the battlefield with burning fuel.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
